title: Overextended rally
intro_say: Angstrom Signals. | Worked example: an overextended rally.

steps.say: Not every Set looks for an entry. | This one is a caution flag: a strong trend that has run very hot.
Add My Trend, and the RSI signal.

steps.screen: Lines: "My Trend is Bullish" and "RSI is at least 75"
steps.say: Line one: My Trend is Bullish. | Line two: RSI is at least seventy-five.
Save it, and run it in Prism.
A Yes doesn't mean sell. | It means: this one has run hard, so think twice before chasing it.
Set it to alert you, and it becomes a quiet warning when a favourite gets stretched.
